description.blurb: S/2004 S 42 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2004 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2004 S 42 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 18.2 million km in 925.91 days. It has an inclination of 165.7° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.158.
